是的。Vibe Coding 之后，很多开发者感觉自己对代码失去了掌控，认为继续下去，将彻底失去控制。

其实这是一个先退化再进化的起伏涨落，先放弃传统控制手段，拥抱新范式，再从新范式里寻找新的控制手段。

当我们从微观确定性编程的控制模式，转向宏观概率性编程的控制模式时，我们会得到新的掌控感，甚至感觉自己比模型更懂代码。

我们可以做到一行代码不看，也比模型更懂代码。作为框架设计者，这种情况已经非常普遍，日常工作中我纠正过 Agent 的误解很多次。

框架设计是一个程序执行模型上的设计，我设计了 A，未来它看代码说 B，我说源码里应该实现的是 A，它再读一遍说“源码支持你的判断，也有相关测试用例……”。

懂代码的第一层是其源码怎么写的，但这不是代码的全部含义，甚至不是我们真正关心的维度。懂代码的重要维度是其表征上、运行上、组合上等不同方面的性质；是这些优秀性质让系统以符合预期的方式运作。

从某个方面说，Agentic Coding，开发者失去的是代码细节的枷锁，得到的是整个程序抽象性质的世界。 开发者对系统的宏观掌控能力，得到史诗级加强，更少无关代码细节占用其短时记忆、工作记忆，更多认知资源投入在 High level 程序性质设计布局中。

quoted_tweet.author: Yufan Sheng
quoted_tweet.text:
在我看来 Vibe Coding 时代，软件工程的那些经验和常识不但没有失效，反而大大强化。无论你用多么强的模型，都无法避免模型慢慢开始拉屎，欠债慢慢提高。

软件开发，首先是个工程，其次才是设计、编码、测试等。换言之，AI 只解决了编码里面的很小一部分，很多模型像做题家一样，还需要人来设计指挥。

Ruby on Rails creator DHH says AI is bringing back the individual hacker's ability to shape the future of computing:

"I love that we have this energy around computers again, like it was in the '90s, the '80s, where hackers and experimenters are suddenly at the forefront of everything."

"I love this energy that now individuals, thanks to the power of AI, can actually play a pivotal role in the forward progression of the industry."

"Once the internet got sort of bottled up and commercialized, a lot of the frontier work to push things forward just got gobbled up by the big companies."

"We closed off all these domains of the consequential bits of the computer. And only the biggest companies in the world could work on them. And now we're re-democratizing it. We're returning it to the hacker culture. We're returning it to the individual who can actually move some of this stuff forward."

@dhh

a16z's Moses Sternstein on why "there is no Gen Z":

"If you take Gen Z and you put them in a room of 99 other Gen Zs, 99 other millennials, 99 other Gen X, 99 other boomers, the odds of them finding a perfect match are almost the same. They actually have a slightly higher likelihood of matching with Gen X and boomers than they do with Gen Z."

"It's definitely heterogeneity, but it also just might be there are more Gen Z tribes... If you're trying to find some kind of uniform cohort, you're just not gonna find it."

"They are fragmented by their different online, by their internet consumption."

"And the implication, whether for politics, for marketing, for institutional trust is, everybody keeps asking, how do we reach the youngs? How do we reach these kids? But the issue is that of course, there is no Gen Z, so it's a hard problem to solve."
